rationale.provenance-auditability: Proposes agent identifiers and activity logging for traceability and forensic accountability.
rationale.org-governance: Discusses oversight structures and real-time monitoring by deployers and service providers.
rationale.intro-framing: Names visibility gaps and outlines potential measures without operationalizing a mechanism.
rationale.general-ai: Focuses on general AI agents across societal contexts, not software engineering.
rationale.non-developer: Discusses delegation of commercial and personal activities by general users.
rationale.agentic: Examines systems acting directly in the world to achieve long-horizon goals.
rationale.risk-security: Provides focal analysis on malicious use and harmful capabilities of agents.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Provides focal analysis on human overreliance and collective dependence on agents.
